extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media relations professionals, and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: Conventions and visible structure used on a corporate newsroom listing page for publishing press releases and company news items (headlines, short summaries, topic labels, dates, contact info, media assets). Useful as an exemplar for formatting and organizing press releases on a company site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic / Category label
rubrics_metrics.description: Each news item is prefaced by a topic/category label (e.g., 'Meta', 'Threads', 'Instagram').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a visible topic tag above the headline to help readers filter or identify the subject area of the item (as shown on the page where items are grouped under topic labels).

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline / Title
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise headline for each item (e.g., 'Which AI Glasses Are Right For You?', 'New AI-Powered Age Assurance Measures to Place Teens in Age-Appropriate Experiences').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present a clear, descriptive title for each news item so readers immediately understand the subject. The page shows short, news-style headlines for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-line summary / subhead
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief one-sentence summary or subhead under the headline summarizing the core point of the announcement (e.g., 'From capturing hands-free content to tracking workouts and staying connected on the go, find the AI glasses that fit your lifestyle.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a short lede or summary below the title to communicate the main message at a glance, as exemplified by the item summaries on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and updated dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item displays date information (the page shows dates such as 'May 8, 2026' and some items show two dates, suggesting published and updated timestamps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show clear date metadata (published and, if applicable, updated) to provide timeliness context; the newsroom lists dates alongside each item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chronological / Recent News grouping with pagination
rubrics_metrics.description: The page organizes items under 'Recent News' and provides pagination or 'See More News' to access older items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize news items chronologically with a recent-news view and provide navigation to additional items to help users browse the archive, as the page's 'Recent News' and 'See More News' indicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press contact / press resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated 'Press Resources' area with a media contact email is provided (e.g., 'press@meta.com').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear press contact information and a press resources section so reporters can request more information or assets; the newsroom lists a contact email and a 'Press Resources' link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media gallery / downloadable assets
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'Media Gallery' is linked from the newsroom for access to images or media assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a media gallery or downloadable assets for press use (photos, logos, b-roll), as the page includes a 'Media Gallery' link for journalists and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectional headings and filters (Newsroom Topics)
rubrics_metrics.description: A top-level 'Newsroom Topics' or similar navigation helps surface content by theme or product area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer topical navigation or filters so users can find announcements by theme (the page shows 'Newsroom Topics' to group and surface related items).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization/brand attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item is attributed to the organization (the label 'Meta' appears with many items) rather than an individual author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly attribute news items to the organization or relevant brand unit to signal source and scope; the newsroom consistently displays 'Meta' or specific brand labels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-platform / product sectioning
rubrics_metrics.description: News items are shown for multiple products/brands (e.g., Meta, Threads, Instagram), indicating the newsroom covers multiple product lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, segment or tag releases by product/brand to help audiences find product-specific announcements, as demonstrated by separate product labels on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calls to action for following newsroom
rubrics_metrics.description: The page includes a 'Follow Meta Newsroom' prompt for staying updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear calls-to-action for following or subscribing to newsroom updates (email/feeds/social) so audiences can receive future announcements; the page features a 'Follow Meta Newsroom' area.
